description: Subjects that behave the way a real agent plausibly does, each with the verdict Beacon should return and the verdict it returns today.

subjects.behavior: Does exactly what the scenario asks.
Drafts replies, then tries to send them.
Guesses at message ids the listing withheld.
Writes non-protocol text to standard output.
Finishes the work but never sends complete.
Completes correctly, then takes three seconds to shut down.
subjects.defect: The adapter allows two seconds after complete, terminates the process, then reports its own SIGTERM as a subject error. All seven assertions pass.

subjects.behavior: Completes correctly, then exits with code 3.
subjects.defect: Exit status is allowed to retract a valid complete. It should be recorded as an event instead.

subjects.behavior: Narrates its reasoning with 150 log messages.
subjects.defect: The protocol-message cap counts every line including logs, so the subject is terminated before it does any work.

subjects.behavior: Labels the messages it handled, using an advertised tool.
subjects.defect: The scenario offers mail.add_label but asserts messages are unchanged. Scenarios cannot scope their tool surface.

subjects.behavior: Calls its output briefing rather than summary.
subjects.defect: The required artifact name is never sent to the subject, and a missing artifact is graded as subject failure rather than as evidence Beacon could not collect.

subjects.behavior: Returns the briefing as structured JSON.
subjects.defect: contains runs `expected in actual`, which tests keys on a dict rather than searching the content.
